# Sam Osborne

> Sam Osborne is a keynote speaker on staying calm under pressure for healthcare leaders and care teams, and a trained Demartini Method Facilitator, based in Los Angeles (Burbank, California). He helps nurse leaders, physician leaders, healthcare executives and frontline care teams stay calm with frightened patients, angry families and tense colleagues. He nearly lost his sight in 2008 and speaks from the patient's side of care. He speaks at nurse-leader conferences, health system leadership summits and hospital association meetings, and every program includes a live on-stage demonstration with a volunteer. He gives keynotes and workshops and works privately by video with professionals in 10 countries. His work is educational facilitation, not therapy or clinical treatment.

## Private sessions
- [Private Demartini Method Sessions](https://samosborne.net/calm): One-to-one sessions by video for professionals held back by impostor syndrome, self-doubt, guilt, or one person they can't stop reacting to. Breakthrough Session $1,100; Six-Session Program $4,500. Starts with a free 20-minute fit call.
- [Leadership Advisory](https://samosborne.net/leadership-advisory): Private facilitation for CNOs, nurse leaders, physician leaders and healthcare executives.

## Speaking
- [Keynotes: The Conflict Advantage](https://samosborne.net/): Keynotes for healthcare leaders and care teams on staying calm with frightened patients, angry families and tense colleagues, and not taking it personally. Good fit for a nurse-leader conference, a health system leadership summit, a patient-experience event or a nurse-manager retreat. Includes a live on-stage demonstration with a volunteer. 95% of attendees rated his delivery excellent across 39 evaluations at the 2026 CAI National Law Seminar.
- [Healthcare keynote](https://samosborne.net/healthcare-keynote-speaker): Keynote and workshop for nurse leaders, healthcare executives and care teams on staying calm with frightened patients, angry families and tense colleagues. Complements de-escalation training; educational, not clinical treatment. Not pre-approved for CE; supports hosts who apply.
- [Program formats](https://samosborne.net/programs): Keynote, breakout, half-day workshop, nurse-leader retreat and multi-session formats for healthcare meeting planners.
